events.verdict: Mitchell (MIA) briefly has a hand on the ball, but Thompson (DET) pulls it away from him to retain full possession. Powell (MIA) then initiates contact with Thompson's arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Powell (MIA) establishes himself in Stewart's (DET) path prior to the contact.
Stewart (DET) legally contests Powell's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Powell's (MIA) shot attempt fails to make contact to the rim and the shot clock expires while Wiggins (MIA) still has the ball.
Stewart (DET) briefly engages with Mitchell (MIA) during the screen.
Mitchell (MIA) legally contests Cunningham's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Stewart (DET) reaches in and the contact with Adebayo (MIA) during his drive is marginal.
Wiggins (MIA) brushes Thompson's (DET) arm and does not affect his shot attempt.
Powell (MIA) places his off-arm against Stewart (DET) during the drive and the contact is marginal.
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) is moving alongside Cunningham's (DET) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Wiggins (MIA) contests Green (DET)"s jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with his arm does not prevent him from following through.
Green (DET) swipes down but the contact with Jaquez Jr.'s (MIA) lower body is marginal.
Mitchell (MIA) and Cunningham (DET) briefly engage and Mitchell releases away to steal the pass.
Cunningham (DET) commits a take foul on Powell (MIA).
